## Small Business Dashboard Blueprint

A simple 3-chart dashboard will show growth, spend efficiency, and customer health at a glance. The dataset is small enough to keep the layout clean and decision-focused.

## Recommended Charts and Key Metrics

### 1) Revenue and Marketing Spend Trend
- **Chart type:** Line chart with two lines
- **X-axis:** Month
- **Y-axis:** Amount
- **Series:** Revenue, Marketing_Spend
- **Why it helps:** Shows whether revenue is rising faster than spend and whether marketing is scaling efficiently.

### 2) New Customers by Month
- **Chart type:** Column chart
- **X-axis:** Month
- **Y-axis:** New Customers
- **Why it helps:** Makes customer acquisition momentum easy to spot month by month.

### 3) Churn Rate Trend
- **Chart type:** Line chart
- **X-axis:** Month
- **Y-axis:** Churn Rate %
- **Why it helps:** Tracks retention health and reveals whether growth is being protected or eroded.

### Dashboard Data View

| Month | Revenue | Marketing Spend | New Customers | Churn Rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Jan | 42,000 | 8,000 | 320 | 4.1% |
| Feb | 46,000 | 9,200 | 350 | 3.8% |
| Mar | 51,000 | 10,000 | 390 | 3.5% |
| Apr | 49,500 | 9,700 | 405 | 3.9% |
| May | 56,000 | 11,000 | 430 | 3.2% |

## 5 Key Insights

- **Revenue is trending upward overall**, rising from **42,000** in Jan to **56,000** in May.
- **Marketing spend also increased**, but revenue grew faster than spend in most months, suggesting improving efficiency.
- **New customers climbed steadily**, from **320** to **430**, which supports the revenue growth trend.
- **Churn improved overall**, dropping from **4.1%** in Jan to **3.2%** in May, with a small setback in April.
- **April looks like a temporary dip** in revenue and churn performance, but May recovered strongly and hit the best revenue and churn results in the dataset.

## Executive Summary

The business is growing in the right direction: revenue is up, customer acquisition is improving, and churn is moving lower overall. A small business owner should focus on maintaining efficient marketing spend while protecting retention, since the best month, May, combines the highest revenue, strongest new-customer count, and lowest churn.

## Quick Actions

- Action: [Button: Build Dashboard] https://www.google.com/sheets/about/
- Action: [Button: Create Charts] https://www.canva.com/graphs/
- Action: [Button: Analyze Metrics] https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/excel

## Sources

- Chart planning reference: https://support.google.com/docs/answer/63824
- Excel chart guide: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel
- Business dashboard basics: https://www.tableau.com/learn/articles/dashboards
